summary: Basejumper crash-landed at base of Grotto Wall climbing area on Independence Pass; stranded ~200 ft above parking area in technical rocky terrain; Mountain Rescue Aspen (13 members) executed guided-line lowering to waiting ambulance; field cleared by 3:00 PM
location: Grotto Wall climbing area, Independence Pass
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff Office
notes: Injuries not detailed in source; lowered to waiting ambulance. Dispatch call ~12:15 PM.
